qa.label: QA/QC environment
qa.name: QA/QC
qa.description: Review documents and analytical results, manage deviations and CAPA, and release batches with your electronic signature.
qa.headline: Quality decisions backed by complete evidence

production.label: Production environment
production.name: Production
production.description: Issue production orders, execute batches against master formulas, receive raw materials and respond to IoT alerts.
production.headline: Batches executed against approved master formulas

administration.label: Administration environment
administration.name: Administration
administration.description: Manage the organization and its plants, invite users, assign roles and manage the subscription.
administration.headline: One organization, the right access for every role

selection.title: Sign in to DoofPlus
selection.subtitle: Choose the environment you work in. Each environment shows the modules and approvals of its role.

sign-in.title: Sign in to the {environment} environment
sign-in.subtitle: Use your work account. Next, you will confirm your identity with a two-factor code.
sign-in.invalid-title: The email or password is incorrect.
sign-in.invalid-text: Check your credentials and try again. After 5 failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.
sign-in.access-note: Access is granted by the role your laboratory administrator assigned.
sign-in.two-factor-text: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to confirm that you are {name} ({email}).
sign-in.code-hint: Codes refresh every 30 seconds. After 5 failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.
sign-in.invalid-code: The code is not valid. Enter the current code of your authenticator app.
sign-in.denied-title: Access not authorized for this environment
sign-in.denied-text: Your identity was verified, but your role ({role}) does not grant access to the {environment} environment. Ask your laboratory administrator to review your role, or continue in your own environment.
